name: Alterna Asesoria Internacional, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Alterna Asesoría Internacional, S.A.B. de C.V. offers extensive asset administration and management services to both individual and institutional investors throughout Latin America. The company's diverse service portfolio includes designing investment portfolios, providing financial advisory, structuring various investment vehicles, assisting with estate planning, and offering insurance consulting. Furthermore, Alterna provides brokerage for a broad spectrum of securities, such as equities, debt instruments, mutual funds, options, warrants, futures, and other derivative products. It also acts as an intermediary for insurance and manages private equity investments. Founded in 2021, Alterna Asesoría Internacional, S.A.B. de C.V. is headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico.
